title: Object Illustrations
slide_intent: Reduce a picture to the features someone can recognize at a small size. A compact shape can guide a reader through several steps without interrupting the text.
strategic_value: Instacart can connect instructions about choosing goods, receiving updates and delivery through a family of concise pictures.
demonstration: A cream How it works panel places a small green illustration above each of three steps. A fruit, an update motif and a bag distinguish the steps.
practical_value: Use this scale of illustration when a short action label needs a quick visual cue beside other steps.

content_islands.name: Object guidance
content_islands.spec: Keep the title and notes about small areas and recognition on the left side of the green field.

content_islands.name: How it works specimen
content_islands.spec: Set a wide rounded panel at right with a common heading. Align each small picture above its own step title and short explanation.
